title: Wheelbarrow Walker Robot
topic: walking worker pushing a free-rolling wheelbarrow, TT motor swing legs

not_matched: pale link is a glued stiffener, not separately driven
flat cardboard instead of rounded print
feet rock toe/heel at swing ends

motor.measured_from: user photo with ruler (~12.3 px/mm); width from standard (photo perspective read 26)

mechanism.name: pendulum swing legs, slot + straw roller, cranks 180 deg apart
mechanism.description: crank pin with straw roller runs in a leg slot on the hip-sole line; leg hangs from a 22 mm hip peg; foot glides nearly flat

sheets.title: Barrow tray, side walls, axle hangers

parts.name: leg L layer
parts.dims_mm: thigh 18 wide, hip-sole 88, foot 54, slot 5.5x26, hip 5.5

sheets.title: Hip plates, cranks, buttons, motor outline
Torso covers, battery pad, hat, washers, switch plate, 1:1 swing check

outputs.full_pdf: templates.pdf (12 pages: 5 templates incl. card + 7 assembly)

card_steps: Cut and fold the barrow tray (sheet 1). Glue the tabs inside.
Skewer axle through a straw under the tray; glue a wheel on each end. Wheels roll freely.
Hot-glue a hip plate (sheet 3) on each flat side of the TT motor, motor upright, shaft in the Ø30 hole.
Glue crank A on one shaft end, crank B on the other: the pins must point opposite ways.
Glue a 22 mm hip peg in each hip hole. Add a 5 mm straw spacer, then the leg (hip sleeve in its Ø5.5 hole).
Crank pin + straw roller sits in the leg slot. Glue button stoppers on peg and pin ends.
Glue torso covers, arms at the shoulders, hands onto the handles with both feet on the table.
2xAA + switch under the tray, wires along a handle to the motor. Switch on and he walks!

assembly_steps.title: Print and check
assembly_steps.do: Print at 100% (Actual size), never 'fit to page'.
assembly_steps.check: The black bar on each sheet measures exactly 100 mm.

assembly_steps.title: Cut out the parts
assembly_steps.parts: Sheet 1 tray, sheet 2 legs, sheet 3 plates & cranks, sheet 4 covers
assembly_steps.do: Glue each sheet on cardboard, then cut on the solid lines.
assembly_steps.check: You have 4 leg layers, 2 plates, 4 cranks, 4 buttons.

assembly_steps.title: Poke the holes
assembly_steps.parts: Sheet 2: Leg L x2, Leg R x2
assembly_steps.do: Poke the Ø5.5 hip holes; knife out the 5.5 mm slots.
assembly_steps.check: A straw slides into the hip hole; a straw fits the slot.

assembly_steps.title: Glue the legs
assembly_steps.parts: Sheet 2: Leg layers x4 + 2 ice-cream sticks
assembly_steps.do: Glue 2 layers per leg, then the pale stick along the thigh front.
assembly_steps.check: Holes and slots line up; leg is flat and stiff.

assembly_steps.title: Add the long feet
assembly_steps.do: Glue a sole stick under each foot, toe forward; add 2 bands.
assembly_steps.check: Both feet lie flat; toe points the walking way.

assembly_steps.title: Fold the barrow tray
assembly_steps.do: Score the dashed lines, fold up and glue tabs inside.
assembly_steps.check: Tray box stands square and does not wobble.

assembly_steps.title: Axle and wheels
assembly_steps.parts: Sheet 1 hangers, skewer 110 mm, straw, 2 wheels
assembly_steps.do: Straw under tray, skewer through, wheel glued on each end.
assembly_steps.check: Spin the wheels: they roll freely.

assembly_steps.title: Hip plates on motor
assembly_steps.parts: Sheet 3: hip plates x2, TT motor
assembly_steps.do: Motor upright (can on top); plate on each side, shaft in Ø30 hole.
assembly_steps.check: Shaft is in the hole centre; hip hole is straight above.

assembly_steps.title: Cranks A then B
assembly_steps.parts: Sheet 3: crank A x2, crank B x2
assembly_steps.do: Glue crank A on one shaft end, then B on the other side.
assembly_steps.check: Look from the side: pins point opposite (180°).

assembly_steps.title: Hip pegs + spacers
assembly_steps.parts: Skewer 22 mm x2, straw 5 mm + 8 mm
assembly_steps.do: Glue a peg in each hip hole, 26 mm above shaft; slip on the spacer.
assembly_steps.check: Peg sticks out straight, not tilted.

assembly_steps.title: Hang the left leg
assembly_steps.do: Slide the leg (sleeve in hip hole) on the left peg; glue a button on the outside.
assembly_steps.check: Leg swings freely, button stops it falling off.

assembly_steps.title: Pin and roller
assembly_steps.parts: Skewer 18 mm, straw roller 6 mm, button
assembly_steps.do: Glue the crank pin, slip the roller on, put it in the slot, button outside.
assembly_steps.check: Roller slides along the slot without catching.

assembly_steps.title: Right leg the same
assembly_steps.do: Repeat steps 11-12 on the other side (crank B).
assembly_steps.check: Legs hang opposite: one front, one back.

assembly_steps.title: Hand-turn test
assembly_steps.do: Turn the shaft slowly by hand for 3 full turns.
assembly_steps.check: No jams; foot sweeps about 54 mm like sheet 4.

assembly_steps.title: Torso covers
assembly_steps.do: Glue the covers on the plate edges with the side tabs.
assembly_steps.check: Cranks and legs still turn freely.

assembly_steps.title: Head and hat
assembly_steps.parts: Ping-pong ball, sheet 4 hat brim + bottle cap
assembly_steps.do: Glue the ball on the neck, brim and cap on top as a hat.
assembly_steps.check: Head sits straight; draw a face.

assembly_steps.title: Arms to handles
assembly_steps.do: Stand both feet on the table, glue hands onto the handles.
assembly_steps.check: Barrow wheels touch the table; feet flat.

assembly_steps.title: Battery and switch
assembly_steps.do: Holder + switch under tray; wires along a handle to the motor.
assembly_steps.check: Wires do not touch the legs or cranks.

assembly_steps.title: First walk!
assembly_steps.do: Switch ON. Walks backwards? Swap the 2 motor wires.
assembly_steps.check: He pushes the barrow forward, wheels roll.

assembly_steps.title: Troubleshooting
assembly_steps.do: Fix the most common problems:
assembly_steps.check: Still stuck? Re-check sheet 4 swing.
